structure_plan.overview: Brick-built chibi minifigure in white robes holding a blue/trans-clear lightsaber; blocky legs, torso with red belt accent, white head with simple face, yellow hair silhouette.

subassemblies.name: A. Base + Feet
subassemblies.description: Small standing base and feet blocks to stabilize figure.

subassemblies.name: B. Legs
subassemblies.description: Two white blocky legs with slight front detailing, attached to base.

subassemblies.name: C. Torso + Belt
subassemblies.description: White torso block with a red belt stripe at waist.

subassemblies.name: D. Arms + Grip
subassemblies.description: Forward-facing arms built from white bricks/plates to hold the saber centered.

subassemblies.name: E. Lightsaber
subassemblies.description: Light bluish gray hilt with a vertical blue/trans-clear blade.

subassemblies.name: F. Head + Face + Hair
subassemblies.description: White head with SNOT face tiles and a yellow hair cap using slopes.

step_outline.title: Base footprint
step_outline.description: Assemble a ~6x6 base using LBG/White plates (3020/3021/3022/3023/3024). Leave 4 studs centered-front for feet placement.

step_outline.title: Left foot + shin
step_outline.description: Build a 2x2 white foot (plate + brick) and stack to a 3-brick-tall shin (3003/3004 + 3022). Place on left-front of base.

step_outline.title: Right foot + shin
step_outline.description: Mirror Step 2 on right-front of base.

step_outline.title: Hips connection
step_outline.description: Bridge the two shins with a white 2x4 plate (3020) at the top to lock legs together; add 1x2/1x1 plates (3023/3024) to square the waist.

step_outline.title: Torso core
step_outline.description: Stack white bricks to form a 4-wide torso (use 3001/3003/3004). Keep front face flat for belt accent.

step_outline.title: Belt stripe
step_outline.description: Add a red belt line around the waist using red plates/tiles (3023/3024 and/or 3069b) on the front and sides. Use red 1x1 tiles (98138) as a small buckle accent centered.

step_outline.title: Shoulders with side studs
step_outline.description: Place two white headlight bricks (4070) at upper-left and upper-right of torso facing forward (studs pointing forward) to mount arm details and help center the saber grip.

step_outline.title: Arms forward
step_outline.description: Build two white 1-stud-thick arms extending forward from the shoulder area using plates/bricks (3023/3004). Use 1x1 plates (3024) to create a 2-stud-wide gap between hands for the saber hilt.

step_outline.title: Lightsaber hilt
step_outline.description: Create a short hilt stack using LBG round tiles (98138) and/or LBG 1x1 plates (3024) with a 2x2 LBG tile/plate (3068b/3022) as a small guard. Fit the hilt between the hands (stud connections).

step_outline.title: Lightsaber blade
step_outline.description: Build a vertical blade above the hilt using alternating TransClear and Blue tiles/plates (3069b/3023), aiming for 6–8 studs tall. Cap with a TransClear 1x1 tile (98138).

step_outline.title: Head block
step_outline.description: Build a 2x2x2 white head on top of torso. Use two white headlight bricks (4070) on the front of the head (studs forward) to receive face tiles.

step_outline.title: Face tiles
step_outline.description: Attach black 1x1 round tiles (98138 Black) as eyes on the two front studs; add a small red/black 1x1 tile (98138) centered lower as mouth.

step_outline.title: Hair silhouette
step_outline.description: Top the head with yellow slopes (3039/3040) to form a rounded hair cap; add yellow 1x1/1x2 tiles (98138/3069b) as smoothing where possible.

notes: Color intent: White robes; Yellow hair; Red belt accent; LBG saber hilt; Blue/TransClear blade.
If 4070 quantities are tight, substitute 87087 for some SNOT points (face/shoulders) and keep face as simple studs.
Keep the saber centered and slightly angled forward by adjusting arm plates one stud outward/inward symmetrically.
Use tiles (3068b/3069b/98138) on exposed fronts (torso/legs) for a cleaner silhouette where inventory allows.
